reviewNotice: Android early-access privacy notice — effective September 14, 2026.This notice describes the current Android build. Early access does not reduce your privacy rights. Contact the developer if the app behaves differently from the choices described here.
agePrivacy: The current Android build asks for an age range on each launch, without saving that answer or asking for a date of birth. Players under 13 cannot proceed. Ages 13–17 can use local play only; adults choose separately whether to start online services, with separate choices for optional reporting. This is a self-declared age gate, not identity-based age verification or a parental-consent system. Earlier private test builds may not have this gate. Where local law imposes higher eligibility or additional safeguards, those requirements still apply.
